record.title: Reconcile public boundary corrections and remaining caller responsibilities
record.intent: Close concrete unchecked-record gaps without claiming isolation from arbitrary Python code.
requirements: Independently rerun original reproducers and inspect corrected entrypoints, run strict and installed gates, verify remote CI and commit and push conclusions.
Document supported validation outcomes and remaining API assumptions, then recheck the authorized deadline before admitting another batch.
acceptance: The corrected contracts are backed by before-after evidence and public installed consumers.
